summary: Learn corporate venture building and intrapreneurship with practical tools, templates, and workshops that support venture cases, launches, and approvals.
lede: Intrapreneurship applies entrepreneurial methods inside established firms to develop and validate new venture opportunities. The course is for innovation, product, strategy and business-unit professionals who need to turn internal ideas into decision-ready venture cases. Participants practice opportunity screening, customer discovery, venture sizing and business-model design, then prepare validation plans, basic funding analyses and executive pitches to support sponsor decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already operate near innovation, strategy, product, or venture governance and need to convert ideas into structured internal opportunities. Innovation managers driving internal venture pipelines and sponsor reviews. Corporate venture leads shaping incubation or new-growth initiatives. Product managers translating opportunity signals into testable concepts. Strategy analysts preparing venture cases and portfolio comparisons. Business unit leaders sponsoring adjacent growth opportunities. Entrepreneurship program managers coordinating internal ideation and selection. Transformation managers linking venture work to operating priorities. Finance business partners reviewing venture assumptions and funding logic. Legal or IP managers supporting venture governance and ownership. Change managers preparing adoption and launch readiness plans.
prerequisites: You need a working knowledge of business operations, basic financial concepts, and access to a laptop with spreadsheet and presentation software. Bring one venture idea, opportunity challenge, or innovation case from your organization if possible, so you can apply the exercises to a realistic context.
